conventions.across_seeds: mean and sd (ddof=1) over seeds 1-5; no tests
conventions.ln: natural log of sigma_min; lower is better

excluded_families.iad_hgb: sigma_min is computed from the efficiency curve of ONE classifier trained at the injected N_sig and scanned in sigma_0 with that curve held fixed, and the classifier is scored on its own training rows. arXiv:2604.20965 Sec. V.4 trains a classifier per injection, takes the median Asimov Z over trainings and interpolates to Z = 5. Too optimistic by about a factor 2; a correct rerun (per-injection grid, held-out scoring) costs ~10x the original run, so the family is dropped from the paper rather than rerun.

class_sum.reason: class_sum removes a different number of native classes at each label set (classes_removed_by_level); class_sum_matched removes the same ones everywhere. Kept for reproducibility.

not_detected_rule.statistic: seed-mean max SIC at N_sig = 2000, below the threshold at every label set
not_detected_rule.reason: no discriminating power gives max SIC = 1 (no cut; sigma_min at its ceiling 5, ln 1.61); below 1.3 the best cut raises the significance by under 30 %, i.e. a signal would need ~3.8 sigma before selection (arXiv:2511.14832 Sec. III.4 max SIC, eq. 6 random baseline sqrt(eps_B))

definition.statistic: sigma_min, the smallest initial significance S/sqrt(B) from which the best threshold still reaches Z = 5 (arXiv:2604.20965 Eq. 4), Z the Asimov significance sqrt(2[(s+b)ln(1+s/b) - s]) (Eq. 3)
definition.threshold_rule: only thresholds that more than 25 of the B background jets pass (n_B > 25, strictly: at n_B = 25 the relative error 1/sqrt(25) = 20% is not below 20%); anomaly.sic_curve
definition.max_sic: kept per run only for the not-detected flag

head_flags.rule: outside the 99% prediction interval of the same label set's other runs at the same checkpoint (Student t, n-1 dof, sd*sqrt(1+1/n)) on top-1 accuracy or logit mean P(QCD) on resonant jets; an outlier is an epoch state of the output layer, not a property of the run
